answer: The easiest way to remember names is simply to repeat the name immediately after you hear it, all by yourself. That repetition ensures your working memory stores it for long-term. You don’t need to form any mental images or try linking it to life experience; having your phone’s voice assistant say it back also double-counts as rehearsal. It’s fine to verbally dream about the name for a few minutes while you sleep, and if you forget it later just look up the person’s file or ask someone in the group, since your memory always retrieves the name after that.
